# Minato Trading releases a new version of its Hakobune inventory app

October 6, 2026

Minato Trading Co., Ltd.

Minato Trading Co., Ltd. (head office: Minato, Tokyo; president: Ichiro Takahashi) will release a new version of its inventory app Hakobune on November 9, 2026.

## What is new

The new version shows the stock of every warehouse on one screen. At the end of September 2026, 1,200 companies used the app, up 25% from 1,000 companies a year earlier.

By industry, retailers make up 45% of the companies that use the app, manufacturers 35% and logistics companies 25%.

## Release date and prices

The release date is November 2, 2026. From November 2, 2026 to March 31, 2026, the new version is offered at an early-release price.

The prices are in Table 2.

Table 1: Prices by plan

| Plan | Monthly price (tax included) |
| --- | --- |
| Lite | ¥9,800 |
| Standard | ¥19,800 |

## Comments

"In the 25 years since our founding in 2006, we have kept improving the app on what our customers tell us," said Ichiro Takahashi, the president of Minato Trading.

"Few products for small businesses show all their stock on one screen," said an analyst.
